messages:
deploy-bot: @channel Deploy started: release/2.4.1 -> production (prod-eu1). Commit: abc1234. Flags: db-migrations=no, feature-flags=deferred. Started by jen. Rolling canary -> 25% -> 50% over ~8m. change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC
jen: watching metrics now, ping me if anything spikes
alex: seeing a small uptick in 5xx from inference-service around +3m after canary promotion
maria: grabbing logs and tracing the pod that reported the errors
deploy-bot: Deployment update: canary healthy -> promoted to 50% at 02:05 UTC
sam: errors continue to climb, p95 latency for inference-service doubled, looks correlated with runtime change in this release
jen: hold promotion. if infra issues, we should rollback quickly. oncall-sre tagged for rollback authority
jen: /deploy rollback --to-tag release/2.4.0 --env prod-eu1 --reason "prod 5xx + p95 latency spike"
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by jen: reverting to release/2.4.0 (commit def5678). Starting revert deploy to prod-eu1. Notifying traffic router to shift away from new instances
maria: logs excerpt: ```
[ERROR] 02:07:12 inference-worker-3 - kv-cache-miss spike
[ERROR] 02:07:14 runtime - CUDA OOM at step 0, allocation failed 245MB
[WARN] 02:07:20 liveness - container restarted (oom_kill)
```
oncall-sre: rolling session caches and pinning runtime while we revert. will check autoscaler interactions
deploy-bot: Revert progress: 0% -> 60% -> 100%. Rolling restart of affected replicas completed
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: release/2.4.0 -> prod-eu1. All primary health checks OK. Duration: ~6m. Incident ticket: INC-2026-45 created.
alex: confirming metrics: 5xx back to baseline, p95 latency returned to expected range. 👍
jen: created follow-up: PR #4321 to revert the runtime change and add stricter canary gating + rollout window constraints
jen: pinning runtime in Redwood Console to commit def5678 until we validate a patch. (Console action by jen at 02:14 UTC)
maria: adding to release notes draft: "Release 2.4.1 reverted in prod-eu1 due to inference OOMs; rollback to 2.4.0 applied. Investigating runtime allocation path. Patch release planned."
sam: will add e2e and perf tests to catch this in CI. scheduling a postmortem sync for 03:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Note: automated canary rollback policy triggered?false manualRollback?true
jen: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for follow-up artifacts (postmortem link, pinned deploy logs). :white_check_mark:
